headline: Axis Securities initiates buy ratings on three diagnostics companies
hook: Axis Securities bets on multi-year diagnostics upcycle
summary: Axis Securities has initiated buy coverage on Dr. Lal PathLabs, Vijaya Diagnostic Centre, and Nephrocare Health Services, citing a multi-year growth upcycle for India's diagnostics sector. The brokerage highlights rising demand, scalable business models, and strong cash generation as key drivers for the industry. Indian retail investors tracking healthcare stocks may evaluate these brokerage recommendations alongside fundamental company data.
why_it_matters: Diagnostics sector sees institutional backing for long-term growth.
winners_losers: Diagnostic stock holders gain / none hurt
